name: Secret Messages
description: Send one-time secrets in direct and group messages, encrypted in the browser for each recipient and burned after reading.

settings_schema.header: Secrets are encrypted in the sender's browser for each recipient. The server only ever holds ciphertext.

settings.help_text: Unread ciphertext is deleted this many minutes after sending. Default 10080 (7 days).

settings.display_name: File secrets can be sent by:
settings.help_text: Who may attach an encrypted file to a secret. Everyone: users in the composer and bots through the API. Bots only: for example the website relay. Nobody: file secrets are off. The largest file is the server's Maximum File Size (System Console > File Storage); each user can hold at most twice that in unread file secrets.
Upper bound on encrypted file data held in the plugin's key-value store across all users, including uploads in progress. Default 2048.
How long a sender has to finish uploading a file before the partial upload is deleted. Default 60.
